crowdsourced_ai_results.analysis: The analyzed binary is a legitimate Windows system component, identified as the RDP Session Agent (rdpsa.exe), used for Remote Desktop Shadowing and Remote Assistance sessions. It implements the CInvitationManager and CRdpSessionAgent classes to manage RDP sharing sessions via the IRDPSRAPISharingSession COM interface. Key behaviors include process hardening via SetProcessMitigationPolicy and DACL restriction (CRdpSaUtils::s_RestrictProcessDacl), monitoring session handles in the registry (Software\Microsoft\Terminal Services\SessionAgent\Handles), and requesting user permission for shadowing via WinStationSendMessageW. The presence of ETW event logging for TS_SHADOW events and standard Windows API usage for session management confirms its role as an OS-level utility.
